texto:
Online shopping has changed how we buy things. Instead of going to traditional stores, many people now prefer to buy products using their computers or phones. The biggest advantage is that it is very convenient. You can shop anytime, day or night, from the comfort of your home. You can easily find everything from clothes and books to food and electronics. Many websites also allow you to compare prices from different sellers, so you can find the best deal without visiting multiple shops.

However, online shopping has some disadvantages. The main one is that you cannot see or touch the product before you buy it. Sometimes, the color or size is different from the picture on the website. To avoid problems, it is important to read customer reviews and check the seller's return policy. This information helps you make a better decision. So, while online shopping is easy, being a smart shopper is still very important.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, what is the main advantage of online shopping?

opciones.B: It is very convenient and can be done from home.
opciones.C: You can touch the products before buying.
opciones.D: You only can buy clothes and books online.
opciones.E: Online stores have better return policies.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es B porque el texto dice explícitamente: 'The biggest advantage is that it is very convenient. You can shop anytime... from the comfort of your home'. Esto significa que su principal beneficio es la comodidad. The other options are incorrect: A is wrong because the text mentions you can 'compare prices', but not that they are 'always cheaper'. C is a disadvantage mentioned in the text ('you cannot see or touch the product'). D is incorrect as the text gives clothes and books as examples, but also mentions 'food and electronics'. E is not stated; the text only advises checking the policy.

preguntas.pregunta: What can be inferred from the second paragraph?

opciones.A: Online shopping is completely safe and has no risks.
opciones.B: All online products look exactly like their pictures.
opciones.D: A careful consumer can reduce the problems of online shopping.
opciones.E: Customer reviews are not very useful.

preguntas.explicacion: La inferencia correcta es D. El texto no lo dice explícitamente, pero da consejos sobre cómo evitar problemas: 'To avoid problems, it is important to read customer reviews and check the seller's return policy'. This suggests that by being careful (a smart shopper), you can have a better experience. Las otras opciones son incorrectas. A is wrong because the text mentions 'disadvantages' and 'problems'. B is incorrect because the text says 'Sometimes, the color or size is different from the picture'. C is not mentioned or suggested. E is directly contradicted when the text says it's 'important to read customer reviews'.
